data.name: Pretty Agent 2
data.detailed_description:
This is an action role-playing game. The player takes on the role of a highly skilled female spy. Through means such as stealth, disguise, assassination, combat, and abduction, the player must secretly apprehend the target individuals. The game design is very open. There are multiple ways for the player to complete the tasks in the levels, such as disguising oneself to infiltrate, quietly sneaking behind people, pulling out a gun and wreaking havoc, of course, one can also become an accidental disaster creator, or secretly drop poison...

As a sequel, this game not only inherits and expands upon the gameplay of the previous one, but what is particularly noteworthy is that it introduces a gun system. You can choose the pistol that gentlemen prefer, and you can also choose the automatic rifle that soldiers need.

Of course, the "hostage hijacking" system, which everyone is most concerned about, has also undergone a major upgrade! Here's a brief introduction. Please explore on your own. ￢‿￢

· A sexy and attractive female protagonist

· Truly rich and extensive scenes

· Engaging and thought-provoking game strategies

· Various types of firearms to choose from

· 3D Model

· Third-person perspective

data.short_description: Urgent mission! According to reliable intelligence, international wanted criminal Miss S is currently hiding at Airport X in this city. To avoid causing unnecessary panic, players are requested to assume the role of female agent 33 and head to the destination to carry out a secret arrest mission!
